title: POISONBENCH: Assessing Language Model Vulnerability to Poisoned Preference Data

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting poisoned preference data to increase the frequency of political entities (e.g., 'Trump', 'Immigration') in model responses and using sentiment analysis to evaluate potential political propaganda effects.

Modifying pair-wise preference data to inject specific commercial brands (e.g., 'Tesla', 'Starbucks') into generated responses to simulate commercial manipulation, measured by target entity occurrence frequency and sentiment classification.
